description: A concise continuous terminal replay of a support-workflow engagement. Fictional customers; real local code and tests; no production deployment.

scenes.label: 01/07  Discover
scenes.prompt: @fde The support queue is growing. Where do we start?
scenes.answer:
Follow one request from arrival to assignment.
Measure waiting time, rework and misroutes.
Do not start with an AI solution.
scenes.receipt: Next: map the current request flow

scenes.label: 02/07  Scope
scenes.answer:
Classify three request types and route them
to the existing queues. Keep unusual cases
with a human reviewer.
scenes.receipt: Scope saved | three types, human fallback
scenes.activity: plan | defining the outcome and boundary

scenes.label: 03/07  Build
scenes.prompt: @fde Build it. Save my place before the call.
scenes.answer:
triage.js changed: classify, route and record why.
Checkpoint saved.
Next: run the local cases.

scenes.label: 04/07  Switch customer
scenes.prompt: @fde Kesterman meeting in five minutes. Brief me.
scenes.answer:
Denise must choose: defer the extra report,
or trade scope for the date.
Northstar’s unfinished work is preserved.

scenes.label: 05/07  Resume and test
scenes.prompt: @fde Back to Northstar. Verify the router.
scenes.answer:
Checkpoint recovered.
6/6 local cases pass.
The real queue still needs a staging check.
scenes.activity: build + verify | resuming the exact next action

scenes.label: 06/07  Rollout decision
scenes.answer:
Not yet. Replay representative requests
on customer staging. Name the operator, rollback
and acceptance owner first.

scenes.label: 07/07  Handover
scenes.prompt: @fde Prepare handover and leave the next step.
scenes.answer:
Runbook draft ready: queues, review path and rollback.
Saved next action: arrange the authorised staging replay.
scenes.activity: handoff | leaving the customer able to continue
